questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2019] 'Moribund Delta' is a sub-division of which of the following Delta ?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) Bengal Delta. "Moribund Delta" is a sub-division of Bengal Delta. The Moribund delta areas are in the south-western part of the country, south of the Ganges river, where tributaries are highly silted and are profusion of Oxbow lakes such areas are Jessore, Kushtia and Faridpur. The immature delta is on the south of the Moribund delta and mainly consists of sea beach and tidally influenced lands. [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2019]

questions.questionTextEn: The Brahmaputra, Irrawaddy and Mekong Rivers originate in Tibet narrow and flow in parallel mountain ranges in their upper reaches. Of these rivers, Brahmaputra makes a “U” turn in its course to flow into India. This “U” turn is due to ?
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 2011] The Brahmaputra, Irrawaddy and Mekong Rivers originate in Tibet narrow and flow in parallel mountain ranges in their upper reaches. Of these rivers, Brahmaputra makes a “U” turn in its course to flow into India. This “U” turn is due to ?
optionsEn: Syntaxial bending of geologically young Himalayas.
Geo-tectonic disturbance in the tertiary folded mountain chains.
optionsHi: Syntaxial bending of geologically young Himalayas.
Geo-tectonic disturbance in the tertiary folded mountain chains.
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Syntaxial bending of geologically young Himalayas.. The Himalayan mountain on their western and eastern extremities are sharply bend southward in deep knee-bend flexures that are called syntaxial bends. Almost hairpin bend occurs on the eastern limit of Arunachal Pradesh, where the mountain changes sharply from the easterly to southerly trend. [I.A.S. (Pre) 2011]

questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 2017] With reference to river Teesta, consider the following statements : 1. The source of river Teesta is the same as that of Brahmaputra but it flows through Sikkim. 2. River Rangeet originates in Sikkim and it is a tributary of river Teesta. 3. questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2006] Which one of the following Indian rivers forms an estuary?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) Tapti. An estuary is a partly enclosed coastal body of water with one or more rivers or streams flowing into it, and with free access to the open sea. Estuaries form a transition zone between river environment and ocean environment and are subject to both marine influences, such as tides, waves, and the influx of saline water; and riverine influences, such as the flow of fresh water and sediments. [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2006]

questions.questionTextEn: Consider the following statements: 1. There are no east flowing rivers in Kerala. 2. There is no west flowing river in Madhya Pradesh. Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 2009] Consider the following statements: 1. There are no east flowing rivers in Kerala. 2. There is no west flowing river in Madhya Pradesh. Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) Neither 1 nor 2. There are three east flowing rivers in Kerala – Kabani River, Bhavani River, and Pambar River. The Tapti (Tapi), Mahi and Narmada rivers originate in Madhya Pradesh and flow from east to west and empty into the Arabian Sea. Thus, both the statements are wrong. [I.A.S. (Pre) 2009]

questions.questionTextEn: Consider the following rivers : 1. Vansadhara 2. Indravati 3. Pranahita 4. Pennar Which of the above are tributaries of Godavari?
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 2015] Consider the following rivers : 1. Vansadhara 2. Indravati 3. Pranahita 4. Pennar Which of the above are tributaries of Godavari?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) 2 and 3 only. The Godavari is the longest river in Peninsular India and the second largest river in India. The major tributaries of Godavari are : Purna, Pranhita, Indravati, Sabari, Pravara, Manjra, Manair. So in the given options Indravati and Pranhita are correct while Vanshdhara and Pennar are not tributaries of Godavari. [I.A.S. (Pre) 2015]

questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following (Tributary – River) is not correctly matched?
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2023] Which one of the following (Tributary – River) is not correctly matched?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) Pranhita – Mahanadi. The Pranhita River is tributary of Godavari River not of Mahanadi River.The Godavari River is the largest river in peninsular India and known as the ‘Dakshina Ganga’. The Godavari Basin is the second largest basin after the Ganges basin and accounts for nearly 9.50 % of the total geographical area of the country. The River rises in the Sahyadris, at an altitude of 1,067 m above mean sea level near Trimbakeshwar in the Nashik district of Maharashtra and flows across the Deccan Plateau from the Western to the Eastern Ghats .The principal tributaries of the river Godavari are Pravara, Purna, Manjra, Penganga, Wardha, Wainganga, Pranhita (combined fl ow of Wainganga, Penganga, Wardha), the Indravati, the Maner and the Sabri. [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2023]

questions.questionTextEn: Compare the Himalayan river with the Peninsular river based on the following comparisons: 1. Most of the Himalayan rivers are perennial, whereas most of the Peninsular rivers are rain fed. 2. The gradient of the Himalayan river is steeper than the Peninsular river. 3. The Peninsular river causes more erosion on its way in comparison to the Himalayan river. Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.questionTextHi: [67th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2022] Compare the Himalayan river with the Peninsular river based on the following comparisons: 1. Most of the Himalayan rivers are perennial, whereas most of the Peninsular rivers are rain fed. 2. The gradient of the Himalayan river is steeper than the Peninsular river. 3. The Peninsular river causes more erosion on its way in comparison to the Himalayan river. Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) 1 and 2 only. The rivers of the Himalayan region rise in the glaciers, are perennial. The peninsular rivers do not have their sources in glaciers and most of them are rainfed. The gradient of the Himalayan river is steeper than the Peninsular river as the slopes of the Himalayan rivers are very steep on the upper reaches. [67th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2022]

questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following cities is not located on the bank of river Ganga?
questions.questionTextHi: [53rd to 55th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2011] Which one of the following cities is not located on the bank of river Ganga?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) Uttarkashi. The prime tributary of Ganga river is Bhagirathi which originates from Gomukh, Uttarkashi district in Uttarakhand. The confluence of Alaknanda and Bhagirathi at Devprayag forms river Ganga. Thus, Uttarkashi is related to Bhagirathi not Ganga. [53rd to 55th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2011]

questions.questionTextEn: In which district of Bihar, Telhar Kund Waterfall is located?
questions.questionTextHi: [67th B.P.S.C. (Pre) (Re. Exam) 2022] In which district of Bihar, Telhar Kund Waterfall is located?

questions.questionTextEn: Which is the Asia's largest and freshwater Oxbow lake in Bihar?
questions.questionTextHi: [67th B.P.S.C. (Pre) (Re. Exam) 2022] Which is the Asia's largest and freshwater Oxbow lake in Bihar?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Kanwar Lake. Asia's largest fresh-water Oxbow lake is the Kanwar lake of Bihar. It is the only Ramsar Wetland site in Bihar located in Begusarai district. [67th B.P.S.C. (Pre) (Re. Exam) 2022]

questions.questionTextEn: Which of the f ollowing statements are correct regarding Yaya Tso Lake? I. It is located in Ladakh. II. It is Ladakh's first heritage site under the Biological Diversity Act. III. It is also known as bird's paradise. IV . It is fed by Sutlej River. Select the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.questionTextHi: [Jharkhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2023] Which of the f ollowing statements are correct regarding Yaya Tso Lake? I. It is located in Ladakh. II. It is Ladakh's first heritage site under the Biological Diversity Act. III. It is also known as bird's paradise. IV . It is fed by Sutlej River. Select the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) I, II and III only. Yaya Tso lake is located in Ladakh. It is also known as bird's paradise for its beautiful lake and is located at an altitude of approx. 4820 meters. [Jharkhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2023]
